dialogue.text: Hi, everybody. In this video, we're going to learn have and has.
dialogue.zh: 大家好。在這個影片中，我們將學習 have 和 has。
dialogue.ja: みなさん、こんにちは。この動画では、have と has の使い方を学びます。
dialogue.local: Hi, everybody. In this video, we're going to learn have and has.
dialogue.en: Hi, everybody. In this video, we're going to learn have and has.

dialogue.text: Now, we use have or has to show possession to show something belongs to you.
dialogue.zh: 現在，我們用 have 或 has 來表示擁有，表示某物屬於你。
dialogue.ja: さて、have や has は所有を表すために使います。何かがあなたのものであることを示します。
dialogue.local: Now, we use have or has to show possession to show something belongs to you.
dialogue.en: Now, we use have or has to show possession to show something belongs to you.

dialogue.text: Okay. So, let's take a look at the board.
dialogue.zh: 好，那我們來看看黑板。
dialogue.ja: では、黒板を見てみましょう。
dialogue.local: Okay. So, let's take a look at the board.
dialogue.en: Okay. So, let's take a look at the board.

dialogue.text: Okay. When you're talking about you or me, we say, I have.
dialogue.zh: 當你談論你或我時，我們說 I have。
dialogue.ja: あなたや私について話すときは、I have と言います。
dialogue.local: Okay. When you're talking about you or me, we say, I have.
dialogue.en: Okay. When you're talking about you or me, we say, I have.

dialogue.text: Okay. If something belongs to a boy or man, we say, he has.
dialogue.zh: 如果某物屬於男孩或男人，我們說 he has。
dialogue.ja: もし何かが男の子や男性のものであれば、he has と言います。
dialogue.local: Okay. If something belongs to a boy or man, we say, he has.
dialogue.en: Okay. If something belongs to a boy or man, we say, he has.

dialogue.text: For a girl or woman, she has.
dialogue.zh: 對女孩或女人，我們說 she has。
dialogue.ja: 女の子や女性の場合は、she has と言います。
dialogue.local: For a girl or woman, she has.
dialogue.en: For a girl or woman, she has.

dialogue.text: For an animal or thing, it has.
dialogue.zh: 對動物或物品，我們說 it has。
dialogue.ja: 動物や物の場合は、it has と言います。
dialogue.local: For an animal or thing, it has.
dialogue.en: For an animal or thing, it has.

dialogue.text: For you, you have.
dialogue.zh: 對你，我們說 you have。
dialogue.ja: あなたに対しては、you have と言います。
dialogue.local: For you, you have.
dialogue.en: For you, you have.

dialogue.text: For us, me and some other people, we say, we have.
dialogue.zh: 對我們，也就是我和其他人，我們說 we have。
dialogue.ja: 私たち、つまり私と他の人たちには、we have と言います。
dialogue.local: For us, me and some other people, we say, we have.
dialogue.en: For us, me and some other people, we say, we have.

dialogue.text: Okay. And some other people, they have.
dialogue.zh: 好，對其他人，我們說 they have。
dialogue.ja: そして他の人たちには、they have と言います。
dialogue.local: Okay. And some other people, they have.
dialogue.en: Okay. And some other people, they have.

dialogue.text: Okay. This is very easy. You just have to remember it. Okay.
dialogue.zh: 這很簡單，你只要記住就好。
dialogue.ja: これはとても簡単です。覚えておけば大丈夫です。
dialogue.local: Okay. This is very easy. You just have to remember it. Okay.
dialogue.en: Okay. This is very easy. You just have to remember it. Okay.

dialogue.text: So, let's practice with these pictures.
dialogue.zh: 那我們用這些圖片來練習吧。
dialogue.ja: では、これらの写真を使って練習しましょう。
dialogue.local: So, let's practice with these pictures.
dialogue.en: So, let's practice with these pictures.

dialogue.text: Here, we have a rabbit and a carrot.
dialogue.zh: 這裡有一隻兔子和一根胡蘿蔔。
dialogue.ja: ここにはウサギとニンジンがあります。
dialogue.local: Here, we have a rabbit and a carrot.
dialogue.en: Here, we have a rabbit and a carrot.

dialogue.text: So, which one do we have to use?
dialogue.zh: 那我們要用哪一個呢？
dialogue.ja: では、どちらを使うべきでしょうか？
dialogue.local: So, which one do we have to use?
dialogue.en: So, which one do we have to use?

dialogue.text: Well, a rabbit is an animal. So, we have to use it.
dialogue.zh: 兔子是動物，所以我們要用 it。
dialogue.ja: ウサギは動物なので、it を使います。
dialogue.local: Well, a rabbit is an animal. So, we have to use it.
dialogue.en: Well, a rabbit is an animal. So, we have to use it.

dialogue.text: It has a carrot. Again, it has a carrot.
dialogue.zh: 它有一根胡蘿蔔。再說一次，它有一根胡蘿蔔。
dialogue.ja: それはニンジンを持っています。もう一度言います、it has a carrot。
dialogue.local: It has a carrot. Again, it has a carrot.
dialogue.en: It has a carrot. Again, it has a carrot.

dialogue.text: Now, in this picture, we have two ants. Okay.
dialogue.zh: 現在這張圖裡有兩隻螞蟻。
dialogue.ja: この写真にはアリが二匹います。
dialogue.local: Now, in this picture, we have two ants. Okay.
dialogue.en: Now, in this picture, we have two ants. Okay.

dialogue.text: So, for two things, we have to use they. Okay.
dialogue.zh: 所以兩個東西要用 they。
dialogue.ja: 二つのものには they を使います。
dialogue.local: So, for two things, we have to use they. Okay.
dialogue.en: So, for two things, we have to use they. Okay.

dialogue.text: So, here are two ants and an apple.
dialogue.zh: 這裡有兩隻螞蟻和一個蘋果。
dialogue.ja: ここにアリが二匹とリンゴがあります。
dialogue.local: So, here are two ants and an apple.
dialogue.en: So, here are two ants and an apple.

dialogue.text: So, we are going to say, they have an apple.
dialogue.zh: 我們會說 they have an apple。
dialogue.ja: だから、they have an apple と言います。
dialogue.local: So, we are going to say, they have an apple.
dialogue.en: So, we are going to say, they have an apple.

dialogue.text: Okay. Let's move on to some more practice.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們繼續練習。
dialogue.ja: では、さらに練習を続けましょう。
dialogue.local: Okay. Let's move on to some more practice.
dialogue.en: Okay. Let's move on to some more practice.

dialogue.text: Let's do some practice together.
dialogue.zh: 讓我們一起練習。
dialogue.ja: 一緒に練習しましょう。
dialogue.local: Let's do some practice together.
dialogue.en: Let's do some practice together.

dialogue.text: You have to think about if we should use have or has in the blinks. Okay.
dialogue.zh: 你要想想空格裡應該用 have 還是 has。
dialogue.ja: 空欄には have か has のどちらを使うべきか考えてください。
dialogue.local: You have to think about if we should use have or has in the blinks. Okay.
dialogue.en: You have to think about if we should use have or has in the blinks. Okay.

dialogue.text: So, let's look at the first one.
dialogue.zh: 那我們來看第一題。
dialogue.ja: では、最初の問題を見てみましょう。
dialogue.local: So, let's look at the first one.
dialogue.en: So, let's look at the first one.

dialogue.text: The girl, blink, long hair. Okay.
dialogue.zh: 那女孩，空格，長頭髮。
dialogue.ja: 女の子、空欄、長い髪。
dialogue.local: The girl, blink, long hair. Okay.
dialogue.en: The girl, blink, long hair. Okay.

dialogue.text: Now, the girl, what can we use instead of the girl?
dialogue.zh: 現在，女孩，我們可以用什麼代替女孩？
dialogue.ja: さて、女の子の代わりに何を使えますか？
dialogue.local: Now, the girl, what can we use instead of the girl?
dialogue.en: Now, the girl, what can we use instead of the girl?

dialogue.text: What can we use instead of the girl? We can say, she.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以用 she。
dialogue.ja: 女の子の代わりに she を使えます。
dialogue.local: What can we use instead of the girl? We can say, she.
dialogue.en: What can we use instead of the girl? We can say, she.

dialogue.text: She, then what do we say? Has.
dialogue.zh: 她，接著我們說 has。
dialogue.ja: she の後は has を使います。
dialogue.local: She, then what do we say? Has.
dialogue.en: She, then what do we say? Has.

dialogue.text: She has long hair or the girl has long hair.
dialogue.zh: She has long hair 或是 the girl has long hair。
dialogue.ja: She has long hair または the girl has long hair と言います。
dialogue.local: She has long hair or the girl has long hair.
dialogue.en: She has long hair or the girl has long hair.

dialogue.text: It's the same. Okay.
dialogue.zh: 意思是一樣的。
dialogue.ja: 同じ意味です。
dialogue.local: It's the same. Okay.
dialogue.en: It's the same. Okay.

dialogue.text: The next one, the boys.
dialogue.zh: 下一題，the boys。
dialogue.ja: 次は、the boys です。
dialogue.local: The next one, the boys.
dialogue.en: The next one, the boys.

dialogue.text: Now, there's a S here. That means there's more than one boy.
dialogue.zh: 這裡有個 S，表示不只一個男孩。
dialogue.ja: ここに S があるので、男の子が複数いることを意味します。
dialogue.local: Now, there's a S here. That means there's more than one boy.
dialogue.en: Now, there's a S here. That means there's more than one boy.

dialogue.text: When we have more than one thing, what do we use?
dialogue.zh: 當有多於一個東西時，我們用什麼？
dialogue.ja: 複数のものがあるときは何を使いますか？
dialogue.local: When we have more than one thing, what do we use?
dialogue.en: When we have more than one thing, what do we use?

dialogue.text: They. Okay.
dialogue.zh: They，好。
dialogue.ja: They です。
dialogue.local: They. Okay.
dialogue.en: They. Okay.

dialogue.text: They.
dialogue.zh: They。
dialogue.ja: They。
dialogue.local: They.
dialogue.en: They.

dialogue.text: Do we say have or has?
dialogue.zh: 我們說 have 還是 has？
dialogue.ja: have か has のどちらを使いますか？
dialogue.local: Do we say have or has?
dialogue.en: Do we say have or has?

dialogue.text: We have to say have.
dialogue.zh: 我們要說 have。
dialogue.ja: have を使います。
dialogue.local: We have to say have.
dialogue.en: We have to say have.

dialogue.text: They have caps or the boys have caps.
dialogue.zh: They have caps 或 the boys have caps。
dialogue.ja: They have caps または the boys have caps と言います。
dialogue.local: They have caps or the boys have caps.
dialogue.en: They have caps or the boys have caps.

dialogue.text: Okay. The next one's easier. I.
dialogue.zh: 好，下一題比較簡單，I。
dialogue.ja: 次は簡単です。I です。
dialogue.local: Okay. The next one's easier. I.
dialogue.en: Okay. The next one's easier. I.

dialogue.text: When we have I, we say have.
dialogue.zh: 當主詞是 I 時，我們說 have。
dialogue.ja: 主語が I のときは have を使います。
dialogue.local: When we have I, we say have.
dialogue.en: When we have I, we say have.

dialogue.text: I have a friend.
dialogue.zh: I have a friend。
dialogue.ja: I have a friend と言います。
dialogue.local: I have a friend.
dialogue.en: I have a friend.

dialogue.text: Okay. The next one is also easy. He.
dialogue.zh: 好，下一題也很簡單，He。
dialogue.ja: 次も簡単です。He です。
dialogue.local: Okay. The next one is also easy. He.
dialogue.en: Okay. The next one is also easy. He.

dialogue.text: He, blink and umbrella.
dialogue.zh: He，空格，一把傘。
dialogue.ja: He、空欄、傘。
dialogue.local: He, blink and umbrella.
dialogue.en: He, blink and umbrella.

dialogue.text: What do we have to use? Has.
dialogue.zh: 我們要用什麼？Has。
dialogue.ja: 何を使うべきですか？Has です。
dialogue.local: What do we have to use? Has.
dialogue.en: What do we have to use? Has.

dialogue.text: He has an umbrella.
dialogue.zh: He has an umbrella。
dialogue.ja: He has an umbrella と言います。
dialogue.local: He has an umbrella.
dialogue.en: He has an umbrella.

dialogue.text: Okay. The next one says the dog, blink, a bone.
dialogue.zh: 好，下一題是 the dog，空格，一根骨頭。
dialogue.ja: 次は the dog、空欄、骨です。
dialogue.local: Okay. The next one says the dog, blink, a bone.
dialogue.en: Okay. The next one says the dog, blink, a bone.

dialogue.text: The dog. What do we use for animals?
dialogue.zh: 狗。動物用什麼？
dialogue.ja: 犬です。動物には何を使いますか？
dialogue.local: The dog. What do we use for animals?
dialogue.en: The dog. What do we use for animals?

dialogue.text: It. It.
dialogue.zh: It，就是 it。
dialogue.ja: It、つまり it です。
dialogue.local: It. It.
dialogue.en: It. It.

dialogue.text: Has a bone or the dog has a bone.
dialogue.zh: Has a bone 或 the dog has a bone。
dialogue.ja: Has a bone または the dog has a bone と言います。
dialogue.local: Has a bone or the dog has a bone.
dialogue.en: Has a bone or the dog has a bone.

dialogue.text: And last, my mother and I, blink, a car.
dialogue.zh: 最後，my mother and I，空格，一輛車。
dialogue.ja: 最後に、my mother and I、空欄、車です。
dialogue.local: And last, my mother and I, blink, a car.
dialogue.en: And last, my mother and I, blink, a car.

dialogue.text: Okay. This one's tricky. My mother and I.
dialogue.zh: 這題有點難。my mother and I。
dialogue.ja: これは少し難しいです。my mother and I です。
dialogue.local: Okay. This one's tricky. My mother and I.
dialogue.en: Okay. This one's tricky. My mother and I.

dialogue.text: We have to say we.
dialogue.zh: 我們要用 we。
dialogue.ja: we を使います。
dialogue.local: We have to say we.
dialogue.en: We have to say we.

dialogue.text: We have a car.
dialogue.zh: We have a car。
dialogue.ja: We have a car と言います。
dialogue.local: We have a car.
dialogue.en: We have a car.

dialogue.text: My mother and I have a car.
dialogue.zh: My mother and I have a car。
dialogue.ja: My mother and I have a car と言います。
dialogue.local: My mother and I have a car.
dialogue.en: My mother and I have a car.

dialogue.text: Okay. So I hope you understand how to use have and has.
dialogue.zh: 好，希望你了解如何使用 have 和 has。
dialogue.ja: では、have と has の使い方がわかったと思います。
dialogue.local: Okay. So I hope you understand how to use have and has.
dialogue.en: Okay. So I hope you understand how to use have and has.

dialogue.text: And I'll see you in the next video. Bye.
dialogue.zh: 下次影片見，再見。
dialogue.ja: 次の動画でお会いしましょう。さようなら。
dialogue.local: And I'll see you in the next video. Bye.
dialogue.en: And I'll see you in the next video. Bye.

dialogue.text: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。
dialogue.ja: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.local: Thank you.
dialogue.en: Thank you.

dialogue.text: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。
dialogue.ja: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.local: Thank you.
dialogue.en: Thank you.
